postCreateCmd: cd autogpt_platform/backend && poetry install && poetry run prisma generate

NODE_MAJOR=$(cut -d. -f1 .nvmrc 2>/dev/null); [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -ge 24 ] 2>/dev/null || NODE_MAJOR=24; cd autogpt_platform/frontend || exit 1; NODE_HAVE=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo v0); NODE_HAVE=${NODE_HAVE#v}; NODE_HAVE=${NODE_HAVE%%.*}; if [ "${NODE_HAVE:-0}" -ge "$NODE_MAJOR" ] 2>/dev/null; then pnpm install; elif [ -s "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" ]; then . "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" && { nvm use "$NODE_MAJOR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm install "$NODE_MAJOR"; } && pnpm install; elif command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then mise exec "node@$NODE_MAJOR" -- pnpm install; elif command -v fnm >/dev/null 2>&1; then fnm exec --using "$NODE_MAJOR" -- pnpm install; elif command -v volta >/dev/null 2>&1; then volta run --node "$NODE_MAJOR" pnpm install; else echo "branchlet postCreate: the frontend needs Node >= $NODE_MAJOR but found $(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo 'no node on PATH'), and no nvm/mise/fnm/volta was detected. Install Node $NODE_MAJOR, then run: cd autogpt_platform/frontend && pnpm install" >&2; exit 1; fi
